format: Packaged-food search mapping (openFoodFacts.ts, usdaFoodData.ts); the HTTP answer is fed in, no network. kind=off_search: input {query, page?, response} where response is cgi/search.pl's JSON -> {results: [{barcode, productName, nutrition, ingredients?, allergens?}], hasMore} (searchProducts; hits missing code or product_name are dropped). kind=off_product: input {barcode, response} (api/v2/product JSON) -> {barcode, productName, servingSize, nutrition} or null (lookupBarcode). kind=usda_search: input {dataType: generic (Foundation, SR Legacy) | branded, query, page?, response} where response is FDC /foods/search JSON -> {results: [{fdcId, productName, nutrition, ingredients?}], hasMore} (searchFoods / searchBrandedFoods). nutrition is NutritionFacts: OFF prefers *_serving over *_100g per field (serving size 'per 100g' when energy-kcal_serving is absent), sodium grams -> mg; USDA is always 'per 100g'. A zero is a value, not a fallback. Out of scope here (Dart-only, tested in app/test/data/packaged_test.dart): brand-leading names, dropping zero-calorie hits, name dedupe. Every case is {kind, name, input, expected}; expected is what shared/src (TypeScript) returns for input. JSON null = a value that is present and null. An ABSENT key = undefined / not set: implementations must treat a missing key and an unset field as the same thing, and must not emit null for it. Regenerate with `pnpm --filter @udine/shared vectors`; never hand-edit expected.
